projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
A new internal analytics dashboard that unifies three data sources into a single visualization layer:

1. Customer CSV processing — ingestion, validation, normalization, and enrichment of customer records exported from business systems.
2. Application log analysis — parsing, structuring, aggregating and anomaly-detecting on application log files.
3. Visualization components — reusable chart/table/KPI widgets assembled into an interactive dashboard.

Goal: deliver a working, observable dashboard with a repeatable data pipeline, validated data quality, and tested UI components. Structure is organized into milestones, each decomposed into tasks small enough to execute in a single focused work session (complexity <= 6/10).

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization, etl

tasks.name: M1: Foundation, Architecture & Data Contracts
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation before any pipeline code is written: repository scaffolding, CI, environment, source-system access, and agreed data contracts for customer CSV and log inputs. Exit criteria: a new developer can clone, run the stack locally, and knows the exact shape of every input file.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Ingestion Pipeline
tasks.details: Build a reliable, repeatable pipeline that lands customer CSV exports, validates them against the contract, cleans and deduplicates records, and loads them idempotently into the storage layer. Exit criteria: daily CSV drops load without manual intervention and bad rows are quarantined rather than silently dropped.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Turn raw application log files into structured, queryable events: parse formats, normalize fields, redact sensitive data, aggregate error signatures, and detect volume/error-rate anomalies. Exit criteria: log data is queryable alongside customer data and anomaly signals are produced on schedule.

tasks.name: M4: Unified Data Model & Metrics Layer
tasks.details: Model the cleaned customer and log data into a consistent analytics schema (facts, dimensions, time grains) and define the KPIs the dashboard will display. Exit criteria: one documented metric layer is the single source of truth for every number on the dashboard.

tasks.name: M5: Visualization Component Library
tasks.details: Build a reusable, accessible set of presentation components (KPI cards, time-series charts, breakdowns, data tables) with consistent theming and explicit loading/empty/error states. Exit criteria: any dashboard screen can be assembled from documented components without bespoke chart code.

tasks.name: M6: Dashboard Assembly & Interaction
tasks.details: Compose the components into the actual dashboard: layout, routing, data wiring, global filters, shareable URL state, and access control. Exit criteria: a user can open the dashboard, filter to a date range and segment, and share a link reproducing the same view.

tasks.name: M7: Quality, Performance & Launch Readiness
tasks.details: Harden and ship: end-to-end tests, load/performance validation, observability and alerting, documentation and runbooks, UAT and launch checklist. Exit criteria: the dashboard is monitored, documented, and signed off by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Scaffold monorepo, linting and CI pipeline
tasks.details: Create the repository layout (ingestion/, transforms/, api/, web/), language/toolchain config, pre-commit hooks (format + lint), and a CI workflow that runs lint + unit tests on every PR. Deliverable: an empty-but-green CI build on the first PR. Keep to a single stack decision — do not attempt to also wire deployment here.

tasks.name: Write customer CSV data contract
tasks.details: Document every column of the customer CSV export: name, type, nullability, allowed values, PII classification, example values, and known quirks (encoding, delimiter, quoting, date formats). Produce a machine-readable schema file (e.g. JSON Schema / Pydantic model) that ingestion will validate against. Scope is documentation + schema only — no parsing code.

tasks.name: Write application log format contract
tasks.details: Inventory the log sources and document the log format contract: line structure, timestamp format and timezone, severity vocabulary, request/correlation IDs, stack-trace layout, and which fields contain PII. Cover both single-line and multiline entries. Deliverable: a written spec plus 3-5 redacted sample log fixtures.

tasks.name: Choose storage layer and stand up local dev environment
tasks.details: Decide the analytical store (e.g. Postgres + columnar tables, DuckDB, or a warehouse) against known data volumes and query patterns, and record the rationale in an ADR. Provide a docker-compose/managed-dev instance so any engineer can run the full stack locally with one command. Do not include production provisioning here.

tasks.name: Provision access to CSV export source and log files
tasks.details: Obtain read credentials and network access for the customer CSV export location and the application log store, confirm delivery cadence and retention window with each owner, and record a 3am escalation contact per source. Deliverable: documented access matrix verified by successfully listing both sources.

tasks.name: Profile real CSV exports and catalogue edge cases
tasks.details: Run a profiling pass over 5-10 real export files: row counts, column fill rates, distinct-value cardinality, date-format drift, encoding issues, duplicated headers, and malformed quoting. Produce an edge-case catalogue that becomes the test matrix. Read-only analysis — no pipeline code.

tasks.name: Build CSV extraction job (discover, read, land raw)
tasks.details: Implement the job that discovers new export files, streams them with a CSV reader that handles the documented encoding/quoting quirks, and lands them unchanged into a raw/bronze zone with file-level metadata (source path, checksum, row count, load timestamp). Keep transformation out of this task.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation and bad-row quarantine
tasks.details: Validate each parsed row against the M1 schema. Valid rows proceed; invalid rows are written to a quarantine table with the failing rule, raw line, and file reference so they can be triaged and replayed. Emit per-run counts of accepted vs quarantined. Deliverable: a replay script for quarantined rows.

tasks.name: Normalize and standardize customer fields
tasks.details: Apply deterministic cleaning rules: trim whitespace, unify casing, parse dates to UTC, normalize country/region and currency codes, coerce numerics and reject impossible values. Every rule should be listed in a normalisation reference doc with before/after examples. No deduplication in this task.

tasks.name: Implement customer deduplication and identity resolution
tasks.details: Define the match key hierarchy (exact customer ID, then email, then fuzzy name+address), implement survivorship rules for conflicting field values, and persist a mapping of source record to golden record. Document the match-rate outcome and keep a manual-review queue for ambiguous clusters.

tasks.name: Make the customer load idempotent with incremental watermarks
tasks.details: Use file checksums plus a per-table watermark to guarantee re-running the job never duplicates rows, and to load only new or changed records. Include a backfill mode and a documented way to safely re-process a specific file. Deliverable: a re-run of the same file produces zero net new rows.

tasks.name: Add run logging and failure alerting for CSV ingestion
tasks.details: Emit a structured run record per ingestion (start, duration, files read, rows in/out/quarantined, errors) and alert the on-call channel on non-zero exit, missing expected file, or a quarantine rate above threshold. Keep alert routing simple — one channel, one severity.

tasks.name: Write CSV pipeline tests against the edge-case catalogue
tasks.details: Build fixtures for each catalogued edge case (bad quoting, mixed dates, dupes, blank IDs) and cover parsing, validation, quarantine, dedup and idempotency with automated tests that run in CI. Target meaningful coverage of failure paths, not a vanity percentage.

tasks.name: Build log line parser for each known format
tasks.details: Parse the log formats catalogued in the M1 contract into timestamp, severity, service, logger, message, and structured key-values. Handle the JSON-lines format and the legacy text format separately behind one parser interface. Unparseable lines go to a reject file with the raw content. No aggregation yet.

tasks.name: Handle multiline stack traces and log continuations
tasks.details: Detect continuation lines that belong to the preceding log entry (stack traces, SQL dumps, wrapped messages) and reassemble them into a single event before parsing. Cover interleaved concurrent writes, which is the usual failure mode. Deliverable: a fixture suite of tangled multiline logs that parse to the expected event count.

tasks.name: Normalize log events into a structured event schema
tasks.details: Map heterogeneous severity labels (WARN/warning/4), service names, and timestamp formats onto one canonical event schema with UTC timestamps and a fixed severity enum. Preserve unknown fields in a raw payload column rather than dropping them. Document the mapping table.

tasks.name: Implement PII redaction and retention enforcement
tasks.details: Redact emails, tokens, IPs, and customer identifiers in log payloads before persistence using documented pattern rules, verify redaction with a spot-check report, and apply the agreed retention window with an automated purge job. This must land before any log data reaches shared/queryable tables.

tasks.name: Build error signature grouping and rate aggregation
tasks.details: Cluster error events into stable signatures by masking variable tokens (IDs, timestamps, numbers) in the message, then aggregate counts per signature per service per time bucket. Persist signature definitions so trend lines stay comparable across deploys. Deliverable: a query returning top error signatures for a time window.

tasks.name: Implement log volume and error-rate anomaly detection
tasks.details: Compute baseline volume and error-rate per service using a rolling window, flag deviations beyond a configurable sensitivity threshold, and write anomaly records with start time, magnitude, and affected service. Validate against a backfilled historical period to tune false positives. Keep the model simple and explainable (no ML required).

tasks.name: Test log pipeline with replay and redaction fixtures
tasks.details: Write tests for parsing, multiline reassembly, severity mapping, redaction (including false-negative checks) and signature stability across deploys. Add a replay test that processes a fixed historical log file and asserts exact event counts and signature totals so future changes can't silently drift.

tasks.name: Design star schema for customers, events and time
tasks.details: Produce the target dimensional model: customer dimension (with SCD strategy for changing attributes), date/time dimension at hour and day grains, service dimension, and fact tables for customer activity and log events. Include an ERD and a table-by-table grain statement so no fact table has ambiguous grain.

tasks.name: Build customer dimension and activity fact models
tasks.details: Implement the transformation models that turn cleaned customer records into the customer dimension (including history/SCD handling) and the customer activity fact table. Add surrogate keys and referential checks. Tables should be materialized and queryable in dev before moving on.

tasks.name: Build log event fact and hourly aggregate models
tasks.details: Implement the log event fact table joined to service and time dimensions, plus pre-aggregated hourly tables for volume and error rate to keep dashboard queries fast. Confirm that aggregates reconcile exactly against the raw event fact table.

tasks.name: Define the KPI catalogue and metric definitions
tasks.details: Write a metric catalogue for every number the dashboard will show (active customers, new customers, error rate, p95 volume, anomaly count, etc.): plain-English definition, exact SQL formula, grain, inclusions/exclusions, and owner. Get sign-off from the business stakeholder so definitions are settled before UI work.

tasks.name: Add data quality tests on the analytics marts
tasks.details: Add automated assertions on the modelled tables: uniqueness of keys, non-null on critical columns, referential integrity, accepted value ranges, and freshness. Tests fail the pipeline run rather than just logging a warning. Deliverable: a CI run showing the tests executing against dev data.

tasks.name: Document data lineage and publish the metric dictionary
tasks.details: Produce a lineage diagram from source file/log to dashboard chart, and publish the metric dictionary in a location analysts can find. Include known limitations and caveats (lag, exclusions, late-arriving data). Keep it to one page per topic so it actually gets read.

tasks.name: Set up component workspace with theme tokens
tasks.details: Initialise the component library package and Storybook, and define design tokens: colour palette (including a colour-blind-safe categorical scale), typography, spacing, and chart defaults. Get one trivial Button rendered in Storybook to prove the toolchain works before building real components.

tasks.name: Build KPI card component
tasks.details: Create a KPI card that shows a headline value, label, unit/format rules, period-over-period delta with correct up/down semantics (more errors = bad, more customers = good), and a sparkline slot. Include number abbreviation (1.2k/3.4M) and locale formatting. Document props in Storybook.

tasks.name: Build time-series chart component
tasks.details: Implement a line/area chart for hourly and daily series with multi-series support, sensible axis ticks, timezone-labelled x-axis, tooltip with exact values, and anomaly markers overlaid as points. Handle gaps in data explicitly (no silent zero-fill).

tasks.name: Build breakdown chart component (bar / donut)
tasks.details: Implement ranked bar and donut views for categorical breakdowns (error signature, service, plan type) with top-N plus "Other" grouping, value labels, and consistent colour assignment across both views. Ensure small-slice donuts degrade gracefully to a bar chart.

tasks.name: Build data table component with sort, filter and paging
tasks.details: Create a table for drill-down lists (e.g. top error signatures): column-level sorting, text filter, pagination, numeric right-alignment, and CSV export of the current view. Virtualise rows once above ~200 items so the page stays responsive.

tasks.name: Implement loading, empty and error states for all widgets
tasks.details: Give every chart, card and table a skeleton loading state, an explicit empty state (with cause and suggested action), and an error state that shows a retry and a correlation ID. Centralise this in a shared wrapper so new widgets get it for free. Demo all three states in Storybook.

tasks.name: Add accessibility checks and component tests
tasks.details: Add keyboard navigation, focus states, ARIA roles/labels for charts, and non-colour-only encoding of meaning. Run axe checks in CI and add render tests for each component including the three states. Document known accessibility limitations rather than silently ignoring them.

tasks.name: Design dashboard layout and information architecture
tasks.details: Produce a low-fidelity wireframe and content hierarchy: which KPIs sit above the fold, customer vs. reliability sections, drill-down paths, and mobile/tablet behaviour. Review with one stakeholder and record decisions. Design artefact only — no implementation.

tasks.name: Build metrics query API endpoints
tasks.details: Expose read-only endpoints for each dashboard view (KPIs, time series, breakdowns, anomaly list) that translate filter parameters into parameterised queries against the metric layer. Include response caching with a short TTL, request validation, and consistent error envelopes. No endpoint should accept raw SQL.

tasks.name: Build dashboard shell, routing and responsive grid
tasks.details: Create the application shell: navigation, page routing for overview / customers / reliability, and a responsive widget grid. Build the grid with placeholder widgets first so layout can be reviewed before real data is wired in.

tasks.name: Wire visualization components to live API data
tasks.details: Connect each widget to its endpoint with a typed data-fetching layer, handle partial failures so one broken widget doesn't blank the page, and verify displayed numbers match the metric layer queries exactly. Include a small number-reconciliation check for the KPI cards.

tasks.name: Implement global filters (date range, segment, service)
tasks.details: Build the filter bar: preset ranges plus custom picker with timezone display, customer segment selector, and service selector. All widgets must react consistently to a filter change, with a single visible loading indicator rather than per-widget spinners. Debounce interactions so typing doesn't fire a query per keystroke.

tasks.name: Sync dashboard state to URL for shareable links
tasks.details: Serialise filters, selected page and drill-down state into the URL query string, restore it on load, and support back/forward navigation. Deliverable: copying the URL in one browser and opening it in another reproduces the identical view.

tasks.name: Add authentication and role-based visibility
tasks.details: Put the dashboard behind SSO, define roles (viewer vs. admin), and enforce visibility at the API layer as well as the UI — hiding a widget client-side is not access control. Verify a viewer cannot reach admin-only metrics by calling the API directly.

tasks.name: Write end-to-end pipeline and dashboard tests
tasks.details: Build a full-path test: drop a sample CSV and log file, run ingestion and transforms, call the API, and assert the rendered KPI values in a headless browser. Include a failure-path test where a malformed file is quarantined and the dashboard still loads. Run on every PR against an ephemeral environment.

tasks.name: Run load testing and tune slow queries
tasks.details: Load the pipeline and dashboard with realistic volumes (e.g. 12 months of logs, 100k customer rows) and concurrent users, record p95 query and render latency, and add indexes or tighten aggregates where targets are missed. Publish a before/after performance report with the agreed targets.

tasks.name: Set up production deployment and pipeline scheduling
tasks.details: Provision production storage and compute, deploy the API and web app through CI, and schedule the ingestion/transform jobs with retries and a defined run order. Include a rollback procedure and a staging environment that mirrors production. Deliverable: one successful scheduled run in production.

tasks.name: Add pipeline observability dashboards and alerts
tasks.details: Instrument job duration, rows processed, quarantine rate, freshness lag and API error rate; build one operational dashboard for them and alert on freshness SLO breach and repeated job failure. Route alerts to the on-call channel and test one alert end-to-end.

tasks.name: Write operational runbooks and onboarding guide
tasks.details: Document the three most likely incidents (failed ingestion, stale data, dashboard 5xx) with symptom, diagnosis and fix steps, plus a backfill/replay procedure and a one-page onboarding guide for new engineers. Validate each runbook by having someone outside the build team follow it.

tasks.name: Run stakeholder UAT and complete the launch checklist
tasks.details: Walk two business stakeholders through scripted tasks (find last week's error spike, compare segments), log discrepancies as tickets, and only then complete the launch checklist: metric sign-off, access review, backup verified, rollback rehearsed, support rota agreed. Deliverable: signed-off launch decision.
